generic_lessons: Core and UI callbacks for the same native notifications can observe different materialized unit state. Record per-context order and facts instead of assuming cross-context atomicity.

A matching operation-start event and actual charge-change notification supply causal evidence unavailable from polling a deleted unit. Do not decode undocumented event tail parameters as success codes.
Adjacent same-turn UI event snapshots isolated a follower change from4to5, unlike aggregate interturn growth that can include ordinary pressure.

An adapter can fail after subscription but before its acknowledgment print. Read back the existing owned handle and restore it before retrying a corrected installation; do not assume the initial error means no side effect.
A native diagnostic success does not repair the product receipt. Preserve the real ARMED failure and qualify a separate implementation against the exact observed event sequence.
